description: Three scheduled agents that prepare MBA class pre-read analyses every evening.

patternsLegend.planning: Decomposes the task: filter -> map -> find -> generate
patternsLegend.multi-agent: Work split round-robin across 3 staggered runs
patternsLegend.idempotency: Skips creating a doc that already exists for the day
